outcome: DNA methylation patterns (differentially methylated cytosines (DMCs) and regions (DMRs))
cohort: The study included 200 newborn infants from whom umbilical cord blood samples were collected and analyzed.
finding: After applying empirical type 1 error control, very little differential DNA methylation was associated with maternal age, mode of delivery, or birth weight, with sex being the only consistently associated variable.
mod_finding: Very little differential DNA methylation was associated with mode of delivery.
